caption: The drawing features a large central star composed of small, diamond-shaped segments arranged in concentric rings, with colors that include red, blue, gold, tan, light purple, green, and white. The star emanates outward from the center, creating a radiating, multi-pointed effect that fills most of the square composition. The background is a solid dark color, likely black, which contrasts with the vibrant pattern of the star. In each of the four corners of the square are large eight-pointed stars, each made up of solid-color sections in shades of tan, gold, light blue, and pale green, set against a black background. Within the spaces between the central star and the corner stars are additional, smaller eight-pointed stars in various pastel colors, including white, gray, lavender, pink, and blue, each outlined and filled with contrasting colors. These smaller stars are grouped near each corner and near the midpoint of each edge of the square. The overall effect is a balanced, symmetrical composition with a rich palette of muted and vibrant shades. The border of the design is defined by a simple, dark rectangular outline, and the entire design is presented on a plain, off-white background.
title: Hooked Rug
